items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Wilson was in that band Willie Bryant had at one time... Bennie Carter was in that band. Ben Webster was in that band.

ctx.x: Yeah. But the band, the guys he had in that band -- Teddy Wilson was with that band at the time.
Yeah, Teddy. Who else was in? Anybody else you remember?
